name: Keshkanti
subtitle: Hibiscus & Bhringraj Hair Oil
tagline: From India's Roots to Your Roots.
description: A restorative, deep-conditioning elixir rooted in centuries of Ayurvedic wisdom. Keshkanti marries the scalp-revitalizing power of Bhringraj with the moisture-locking grace of Hibiscus to nourish hair at its foundation. Grounded in a base of cold-pressed Sesame and vitamin-rich Amla, this oil helps curb everyday hair fall, strengthens strands against environmental stress, and leaves your hair with a natural, reflective lustre.

ingredients.name: Hibiscus Flower
ingredients.role: Natural conditioning and softening agent to prevent dryness

ingredients.name: Bhringraj Leaves
ingredients.role: Strengthens hair roots and reduces hair fall

ingredients.name: Amla Fruit
ingredients.role: Vitamin C-rich antioxidant that enhances natural luster and scalp health

ingredients.name: Sesame Seed Oil
ingredients.role: Deeply penetrative base oil that nourishes the scalp

whyThisHerb: Bhringraj, known in Ayurveda as the ‘King of Hair,’ goes deep to revitalize follicles, while Hibiscus acts as a natural humectant, offering the rich, natural conditioning your hair needs to thrive.

howToUse.title: Dispense
howToUse.description: Pour a generous amount of oil into your palms and gently rub them together to slightly warm the blend.

howToUse.title: Massage
howToUse.description: Apply to your scalp, using your fingertips to massage in circular motions, focusing on the roots, then work the remaining oil through the lengths.

howToUse.title: Rest
howToUse.description: Leave the oil on for at least 30 minutes, or overnight for a deeply nourishing treatment.

howToUse.title: Rinse
howToUse.description: Wash thoroughly with a mild herbal shampoo. Use 2–3 times a week for best results.
